name: OpenClaw (Secure)
description: Self-hosted personal AI assistant via Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp and more. Secure Railway template with loopback-only gateway, token auth, setup wizard, persistent state volume, safe default tool policy, and optional automatic browser device approval.

variables.name: AUTO_APPROVE_LATEST_DEVICE
variables.description: If true, the wrapper periodically approves the latest pending browser device. Convenient, but weaker security.

variables.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
variables.description: Optional. Enables OpenRouter models, including openrouter/auto.

variables.name: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN
variables.description: Optional. Slack Bot User OAuth Token (xoxb-...).

variables.name: SLACK_APP_TOKEN
variables.description: Optional. Slack App-Level Token (xapp-...). Required with SLACK_BOT_TOKEN for Socket Mode.
